name: sheldonhenriques/ag2-demo
snippet: AG2 Demo - Multi-Agent Reddit Content Strategy System A Python-based multi-agent system using AutoGen (AG2) that automates Reddit content strategy workflow. The system uses multiple AI agents to research trending topics, develop content strategies, create viral-ready posts, and handle the posting process with human approval. - Research Agent: Analyzes trending topics and community engagement patterns on Reddit - Content Strategist: Creates actionable content strategies based on research data - Content Adapter: Transforms strategies into viral-ready Reddit posts - Reddit Poster: Handles posting with human-in-the-loop approval - Project Coordinator: Manages the entire workflow between agents Run the main script to start the multi-agent workflow: python main.py The system will: 1. Research trending posts in the target subreddit (default: r/LLM) 2. Develop content strategy based on the research 3. Create a viral-ready post 4. Request human approval before posting 5. Post to Reddit upon approval - ag2[gemini] - AutoGen framework with Google Gemini support - python-dotenv - Environment variable management - praw - Python Reddit API Wrapper 1. Research Phase: The research agent fetches trending posts from the specified subreddit 2. Strategy Phase: The content strategist analyzes the data and creates content recommendations 3. Adaptation Phase: The content adapter creates a specific, ready-to-post content piece 4. Approval Phase: The system presents the post to a human for approval 5. Posting Phase: Upon approval, the post is submitted to Reddit ---
